posts.title: How the Red Ferrari Night Held Together
posts.summary: Thirty-five frames of one night in 1979, and the part that actually makes them agree with each other: the cast and the rooms, defined once and wired into every shot that needs them.

posts.title: From Character Sheet to Walk Cycle
posts.summary: A character sheet is a promise of motion. The Cycle node keeps it: turn a pinned pose into keyed frames, composite them over a background, then hand-pick the twelve that make a true loop.
posts.hero_alt: Character sheet for Mason, front and side views from the shoulders up, blond hair with a red streak

posts.summary: The authenticated FlowBoard dashboard project for the Houseboat demo shows a compact but complete workflow: Scene capture, reference-driven outputs, page layout, and a final refinement pass that keeps composition stable while changing medium.
